header.title: {{term}} Information
header.subtitle: Set up the class details, then continue to participants & access.

sections.basicInfoDesc: Title, subject and a short description of the class.
sections.scheduleDesc: Choose between a one-time class or a recurring weekly schedule.
sections.streamingDesc: Where learners join the class and which platform you stream from.
sections.waitingDesc: Lock playback controls and configure the learner waiting room.
sections.feedbackDesc: Collect ratings and comments after the session ends.
sections.customButtonDesc: Optional button shown on the learner's session screen.
sections.recurringDesc: Pick days and per-day session times for the recurring series.

basicInfo.descriptionHint: (Provide a brief overview of your live class. You can include text, emojis, images, or posters to give participants a quick idea of what the session is about)
basicInfo.showToLearnersOnHint: On: learners see this class and can join it like a normal live class.
basicInfo.showToLearnersOffHint: Off: offline class. Learners won't see it or get notified; only attendance is marked.

bbb.restrictionsHint: Restrictions apply to participants only — the host always keeps full access.
bbb.noCamera: Participants can't turn on their camera
bbb.noCameraShort: participants can't turn on their camera
bbb.noPrivateChat: Participants can't private message each other
bbb.noPublicChat: Participants can't send messages in class chat
bbb.hideUserList: Participants can't see who else is in the class
bbb.endWhenNoModerator: End class automatically after the host leaves
bbb.activenessScoreHint: Learners' cameras turn on automatically for a live activeness score (they can turn it off). The camera is processed on their device; only the score is saved. Applies when the class is started after saving.
bbb.lectureHintIntro: Running a large lecture or webinar? Turn on
bbb.lectureHintOutro: , and have the host share slides rather than their screen. A class set up this way puts far less load on the server than one where everyone can unmute and switch a camera on.

feedback.title: Learner Feedback Settings
feedback.hint: When enabled, learners see a feedback form after the session ends.
feedback.compulsoryHint: Learners cannot skip the form — all required questions must be answered.

defaultQuestions.learnings: What did you learn in the session?
defaultQuestions.doubts: Any doubts or questions you have?

streaming.platformHint: (Do you want the students to view the class in the learner app, or do you want to redirect them to the app that is hosting the live session?)

waiting.preJoiningHint: Let learners join the live class directly during the window before it starts.
waiting.waitingRoomHint: Turn this on to give learners early access before the class starts — they either wait in a waiting room (with an optional thumbnail and background music) or join the live class directly (Pre-Joining), depending on the Waiting Room Type you choose.
waiting.coverHint: Hero background of the public registration page (and the waiting-room backdrop). A wide landscape image works best.

recurring.title: Recurring Schedule
recurring.customButtonHint: This button will be visible to learners on the Live Session screen and the Default Session screen.

dialogs.defaultLinkHint: Select the days you want to apply this default link to:
dialogs.copySessionHint: Select the days you want to copy this session to:
dialogs.copyDefaultLinkTitle: Copy Default Link to Other Days
dialogs.copyDefaultLinkHint: Select the days you want to copy this default link to:
dialogs.linkChangeTitle: You've changed the class link. Where do you want to apply this change?
dialogs.onlyThisSessionDesc: Apply the new link to only this one session on {{day}}.
dialogs.allSessionsThisDayDesc: Apply the new link for all sessions on this {{day}}.
dialogs.upcomingSessionsDesc: Apply the new link to this session on every upcoming {{day}}.
dialogs.upcomingAllSessionsDesc: Apply the new link for all sessions on all upcoming occurrences of this day.
dialogs.upcomingAllSessionsExample: Example: All 6 sessions on every future {{day}} will have the new link.
